title: Stage 4: Roles, 401 and 403
summary: Seed an admin, add admin-only endpoints, and get the status codes exactly right.

steps.title: Stage 4: admins
body: - Seed one admin at startup: `root` / `root-password-1`, role `admin` (hashed like everyone else). New registrations stay `user`.
- `GET /admin/users`: anonymous `401`, non-admin `403`, admin `200` with `[{"username","role"}]` sorted by username, never hashes.
- `POST /admin/users/{name}/role {"role":"admin"}`: admins only; role must be `user` or `admin` (`400`), unknown user `404`, else `200`.
A role change shows up in the user's **next** token. Tokens already issued keep their old `role` claim until they expire, which is one reason access tokens are short-lived.

code: var user = new ClaimsPrincipal(new ClaimsIdentity([new Claim("sub", "lin"), new Claim("role", "user")], "Bearer", "sub", "role"));
int Gate(ClaimsPrincipal p) => p.Identity?.IsAuthenticated != true ? 401 : p.IsInRole("admin") ? 200 : 403;

steps.title: Admin endpoints
prompt: Implement stage 4. **Run checks** starts your server and calls it, logging in as `root` and as new users.
- Seed one admin at startup: `root` / `root-password-1`, role `admin`, hashed like everyone else. New registrations stay `user`. Logging in as root gives a token with `role` `admin`.
- `GET /admin/users`: anonymous `401` (with `WWW-Authenticate: Bearer`), non-admin `403`, admin `200` with `[{"username", "role"}]` sorted by username. Never include hashes.

- `POST /admin/users/{name}/role` with body `{"role": "admin"}`: anonymous `401`, non-admin `403`; a role other than `user` or `admin` -> `400`; an unknown user -> `404`; else change the stored role and answer `200`.
- The role comes from the token, so a promoted user's **old** token still says `user` (`403`); their next login gets `admin`.
`/register`, `/login` and `/me` from the earlier stages must keep working.

static class DojoTests
public static async Task Run(HttpClient http)
await Dojo.TryAsync("Registration could be checked", async () =>
var r = await T.Post(http, "/register", new { username = "ada", password = "correct horse" });
DojoWeb.Status("POST /register ada gets 201", 201, r);
var text = await DojoWeb.Text(r);
Dojo.Eq("the body names the user", "ada", DojoWeb.Prop(await DojoWeb.Json(r), "username"));
Dojo.Check("the response never contains the password or its hash", !text.Contains("correct horse") && !text.Contains("pbkdf2") && !text.Contains("hash", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase), text);
DojoWeb.Status("registering ada again gets 409", 409, await T.Post(http, "/register", new { username = "ADA", password = "another-pass" }));
DojoWeb.Status("a 7-character password gets 400", 400, await T.Post(http, "/register", new { username = "grace", password = "1234567" }));
DojoWeb.Status("a 2-character username gets 400", 400, await T.Post(http, "/register", new { username = "gh", password = "long-enough" }));
DojoWeb.Status("a missing password gets 400", 400, await T.Post(http, "/register", new { username = "grace" }));
DojoWeb.Status("grace registers", 201, await T.Post(http, "/register", new { username = "grace", password = "hopper-1906" }));
await Dojo.TryAsync("Login could be checked", async () =>
DojoWeb.Status("ada logs in", 200, await T.Post(http, "/login", new { username = "ada", password = "correct horse" }));
var wrong = await T.Post(http, "/login", new { username = "ada", password = "correct h0rse" });
var unknown = await T.Post(http, "/login", new { username = "nobody", password = "correct horse" });
DojoWeb.Status("a wrong password gets 401", 401, wrong);
DojoWeb.Status("an unknown user gets 401", 401, unknown);
Dojo.Eq("both failures have the same message", await DojoWeb.Text(wrong), await DojoWeb.Text(unknown));
DojoWeb.Status("grace's password doesn't open ada's account", 401, await T.Post(http, "/login", new { username = "ada", password = "hopper-1906" }));
await Dojo.TryAsync("Access tokens could be checked", async () =>
await T.Post(http, "/register", new { username = "turing", password = "enigma-1912" });
var json = await T.Login(http, "turing", "enigma-1912");
var token = DojoWeb.Prop(json, "access_token");
Dojo.Eq("token_type is Bearer", "Bearer", DojoWeb.Prop(json, "token_type"));
Dojo.Eq("expires_in is 900", "900", DojoWeb.Prop(json, "expires_in"));
Dojo.Check("the token is a JWT signed with the signing key", T.Signed(token), token ?? "no access_token");
var p = T.Payload(token);
Dojo.Eq("iss", "https://secure-api.dojo", DojoWeb.Prop(p, "iss"));
Dojo.Eq("aud", "secure-api", DojoWeb.Prop(p, "aud"));
Dojo.Eq("sub", "turing", DojoWeb.Prop(p, "sub"));
Dojo.Eq("role", "user", DojoWeb.Prop(p, "role"));
Dojo.Eq("exp - iat is 900", "900", (long.Parse(DojoWeb.Prop(p, "exp") ?? "0") - long.Parse(DojoWeb.Prop(p, "iat") ?? "0")).ToString());
Dojo.Check("there is a jti", !string.IsNullOrEmpty(DojoWeb.Prop(p, "jti")), "no jti");
var second = T.Payload(DojoWeb.Prop(await T.Login(http, "turing", "enigma-1912"), "access_token"));
Dojo.Check("each token has its own jti", DojoWeb.Prop(second, "jti") != DojoWeb.Prop(p, "jti"), "same jti twice");
Dojo.Eq("a failed login returns no token", null, DojoWeb.Prop(await T.Login(http, "turing", "nope-nope"), "access_token"));
await Dojo.TryAsync("The bearer middleware could be checked", async () =>
await T.Post(http, "/register", new { username = "hopper", password = "cobol-1959" });
var token = DojoWeb.Prop(await T.Login(http, "hopper", "cobol-1959"), "access_token");
var me = await T.Send(http, HttpMethod.Get, "/me", token);
DojoWeb.Status("GET /me with the login token gets 200", 200, me);
var mj = await DojoWeb.Json(me);
Dojo.Eq("username", "hopper", DojoWeb.Prop(mj, "username"));
Dojo.Eq("role", "user", DojoWeb.Prop(mj, "role"));
var anon = await T.Send(http, HttpMethod.Get, "/me", null);
DojoWeb.Status("GET /me without a token gets 401", 401, anon);
Dojo.Check("with WWW-Authenticate: Bearer", anon.Headers.WwwAuthenticate.ToString().StartsWith("Bearer"), anon.Headers.WwwAuthenticate.ToString());
DojoWeb.Status("an expired token gets 401", 401, await T.Send(http, HttpMethod.Get, "/me", T.For("hopper", exp: 1000000000)));
DojoWeb.Status("a token for another audience gets 401", 401, await T.Send(http, HttpMethod.Get, "/me", T.For("hopper", aud: "other-api")));

DojoWeb.Status("a token signed with another key gets 401", 401, await T.Send(http, HttpMethod.Get, "/me", T.Sign("{\"iss\":\"https://secure-api.dojo\",\"aud\":\"secure-api\",\"sub\":\"hopper\",\"exp\":4102444800}", new byte[32])));

DojoWeb.Status("a test-made token is accepted", 200, await T.Send(http, HttpMethod.Get, "/me", T.For("someone")));

await T.Post(http, "/register", new { username = "lin", password = "lin-password" });
var user = DojoWeb.Prop(await T.Login(http, "lin", "lin-password"), "access_token");
var root = DojoWeb.Prop(await T.Login(http, "root", "root-password-1"), "access_token");
Dojo.Eq("root's token carries role admin", "admin", DojoWeb.Prop(T.Payload(root), "role"));
DojoWeb.Status("GET /admin/users anonymously gets 401", 401, await T.Send(http, HttpMethod.Get, "/admin/users", null));
DojoWeb.Status("GET /admin/users as a user gets 403", 403, await T.Send(http, HttpMethod.Get, "/admin/users", user));
var list = await T.Send(http, HttpMethod.Get, "/admin/users", root);
DojoWeb.Status("GET /admin/users as root gets 200", 200, list);
var text = await DojoWeb.Text(list);
var lj = await DojoWeb.Json(list);
var names = lj.ValueKind == JsonValueKind.Array ? lj.EnumerateArray().Select(u => DojoWeb.Prop(u, "username") ?? "").ToList() : new List<string>();
Dojo.Check("it lists lin and root", names.Contains("lin") && names.Contains("root"), string.Join(",", names));
Dojo.Check("sorted by username", names.SequenceEqual(names.OrderBy(n => n, StringComparer.Ordinal)), string.Join(",", names));
Dojo.Check("without password hashes", !text.Contains("pbkdf2"), text);

static class T
public static string B64(byte[] d) => Convert.ToBase64String(d).TrimEnd('=').Replace('+', '-').Replace('/', '_');
public static string B64(string s) => B64(System.Text.Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(s));
public static readonly byte[] Key = System.Text.Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes("secure-the-api-signing-key-0123456789");
public static string Sign(string payload, byte[]? key = null)
var input = B64("{\"alg\":\"HS256\",\"typ\":\"JWT\"}") + "." + B64(payload);
return input + "." + B64(System.Security.Cryptography.HMACSHA256.HashData(key ?? Key, System.Text.Encoding.ASCII.GetBytes(input)));
public static string For(string sub, string role = "user", long exp = 4102444800, string aud = "secure-api") =>
public static JsonElement Payload(string? jwt)
var p = (jwt ?? "").Split('.');
if (p.Length != 3) return default;
var s = p[1].Replace('-', '+').Replace('_', '/');
try { return JsonDocument.Parse(Convert.FromBase64String(s.PadRight(s.Length + (4 - s.Length % 4) % 4, '='))).RootElement; }
catch { return default; }
public static bool Signed(string? jwt)
var p = (jwt ?? "").Split('.');
return p.Length == 3 && B64(System.Security.Cryptography.HMACSHA256.HashData(Key, System.Text.Encoding.ASCII.GetBytes(p[0] + "." + p[1]))) == p[2];
public static Task<HttpResponseMessage> Post(HttpClient http, string url, object body) => http.PostAsJsonAsync(url, body);
public static Task<HttpResponseMessage> Send(HttpClient http, HttpMethod m, string url, string? token, object? body = null)
var msg = new HttpRequestMessage(m, url);
if (token is not null) msg.Headers.TryAddWithoutValidation("Authorization", "Bearer " + token);
if (body is not null) msg.Content = JsonContent.Create(body);
return http.SendAsync(msg);
public static async Task<JsonElement> Login(HttpClient http, string user, string password) =>
await DojoWeb.Json(await http.PostAsJsonAsync("/login", new { username = user, password }));
